t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colours seem to change regularly. Try to remember what each colour gives you as the amount can change.

vb_textbox.text: I found the taller gnomes seemed to give more mushrooms rather than the smaller ones. Also, certain colours seem to be better than others. Try to remember what each colour gives you (the amount of mushrooms) although they do keep changing throughout the rounds. Even though you get a decent amount of time to choose a colour i sometimes found myself missing clicking so just try to concentrate as much as possible.
